overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies Tomato Powder in bulk for food manufacturers, seasoning blenders, private label brands and distributors. We are an FSSAI-registered manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter from India. The powder is made from carefully selected ripe tomatoes and delivers concentrated tomato flavour, consistent colour and a shelf-stable alternative to fresh tomatoes, purees and pastes.

We supply both conventional dehydrated and free-flowing spray dried tomato powder. The standard grade is 80 mesh, with custom fine or coarse ranges available on request. Our process covers sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch. OEM and private label support is available, along with samples on request.
highlights: Standard 80 mesh, custom mesh on request
industries: Instant food and ready meal brands

faqs.q: What is your MOQ for Tomato Powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 Kg, so you can trial the product before scaling up.

faqs.q: What mesh size do you supply?
faqs.a: The standard grade is 80 mesh. Finer or coarser ranges can be arranged on request.

faqs.q: Do you offer dehydrated and spray dried tomato powder?
faqs.a: Yes. Both conventional dehydrated and free-flowing spray dried tomato powder are available, matched to your application.
